note: Packaging is software; certification is hardware. Every target below is BUILDABLE and none is CERTIFIED. A package that starts on a device proves the image is correct, not that the device is supported — that requires `vip certify` against the physical unit, and until then the compatibility registry keeps the device at 'pending-validation'.

docker-generic.label: Generic Docker host (x86-64)
docker-generic.notes: The reference package. No accelerator assumed; sub-stream analysis is essential.
prerequisites: a host clock synced by NTP (event ordering depends on it)

industrial-pc.label: Industrial PC (fanless, DIN-rail)
industrial-pc.notes: Wide-temperature hardware for factory floors. Same software as docker-generic; the differences that matter are thermal and are only discoverable by soak.
prerequisites: wide-temperature-rated storage — SD cards fail first in this class

intel-nuc.label: Intel NUC
intel-nuc.notes: Same image as mini-pc; kept as its own target because NUC thermal behaviour under a 24h soak is a separate question from a generic mini-PC's.
prerequisites: adequate ventilation — thermal throttling under soak is the expected failure mode

jetson.label: NVIDIA Jetson (Orin Nano / Xavier NX)
jetson.notes: JetPack-matched base image; the L4T tag MUST match the device's JetPack version or CUDA will not initialise.
prerequisites: the L4T base tag matching the installed JetPack

mini-pc.label: Mini PC (Intel i5, no discrete GPU)
mini-pc.notes: Adds the OpenVINO execution provider. The single-site default.
